 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Chandra Shekhar Jha
 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. The accused-petitioner, named in the complaint, is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 1374C/2023 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 323/498A of the Indian Penal Code and  of Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. The allegation against the petitioner is to commit mental and physical cruelty upon the complainant alongwith other co- accused persons/family members due to non-fulfillment of demand of cash of Rs. 10 lacs and one Enova Car as dowry.

4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submitted that allegation as raised through complaint petition qua Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.60523 of 2024(5) dt.03-02-2026 mental and physical cruelty is appearing very much general and omnibus in nature against the petitioner.

It is further submitted that the last occurrence as per complaint took place on 28.02.2023, the day on which the complainant alleged to be ousted from her matrimonial home but the complaint in issue was filed on 01.08.2023 i.e. almost after six months without any explanation for such inordinate delay and, furthermore, the complaint in issue is not supported by affidavit, which is contrary to the Niraj Kumar @ Neeraj Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 3 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59482932/

sentences.text: Petitioner claimed clean antecedent.
5. Learned A.P.P. opposed the prayer of anticipatory bail.
6. On repeated calls, none appeared on behalf of the complainant to join the present proceeding.

7. In view of aforesaid factual submission and by taking note of the fact as allegation qua committing mental and physical cruelty appears very much general and omnibus against petitioner,, whereas the present complaint appears to be lodged after a gap of about six months without any explanation,

accordingly, above-named petitioner, in the event of his arrest/surrender within a period of four weeks from this order, is directed to be enlarged on bail on furnishing of bail bond of Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.60523 of 2024(5) dt.03-02-2026 Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned District and Sessions Judge,

Begusarai/concerned court in connection with Complaint Case No. 1374C/2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C/Section 482(2) of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (in short "B.N.S.S.").

(Chandra Shekhar Jha, J) veena/-
